about.text: Ziger (Zieger in Germany and Austria) is a Swiss whey cheese: the whey protein is precipitated with acid, alone or with some skimmed milk or buttermilk. It is not aged, and is sold fresh or smoked.

how.text: Hot whey plus acid makes the whey proteins flocculate; the flocs are ladled into moulds and drained. No starter and no rennet. Schabziger from Glarus is a related but separate cheese, flavoured with Zigerklee.
